drafted_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (assistant) - draft for operator review
question: Trained on 11 structures, can the ablated-MoE hyperbolic spine rank dehydron nodes on a held-out structure better than chance under wrap=1, when the edge-type input is removed?

design.sdrp_coeff_note: EXPLICIT: the pinned default is SDRP_LOSS_COEFF=0.1; this card sets it to 0.0 because SDRP is parked (tokyo_eye_equ_sdrp_target_wrap1_close). The SDRP head stays in the forward pass but receives zero loss weight; no loader, label or cache-key change. SDRP metrics are logged as diagnostics and are not used for any bar.

frontend.pretrained_bank: NOT AVAILABLE - checkpoints/v8/pretrained/ does not exist in this environment
frontend.claim_consequence: Results speak to the cold SE(3)-lite frontend + hyperbolic spine, NOT to a pretrained EquiformerV3 backbone. A pretrained-bank arm needs the checkpoint present and a separate card.

protocol.split: leave-one-structure-out (LOSO), 12 folds: train on 11, evaluate on the 1 held-out structure
protocol.group_rule: Before folds are frozen, record pairwise sequence identity of the 12 chains (science/tokyo_eye/v8/seq_cluster.py tooling if usable offline; otherwise state that the check could not be run). Any pair >= 30% identity is held out together as one fold group. Result is reported either way.
protocol.epochs_note: PROPOSED. About 3x-5x the earlier 38/60-epoch stubs; fixed in advance. One optimizer step per epoch on the MEAN gradient over the 11 training structures (same aggregation as run_epoch_mean_structures in the approved MoE/eps card). lr unchanged.
protocol.model_selection: NONE. No early stopping, no best-epoch pick, no checkpoint selection on the held-out structure. The reported number is the LAST epoch. Held-out metrics logged during training are read-only diagnostics.
protocol.eval: eval mode, tau = tau_end (0.995), same as the wrap1 rescore stamp; dehydron score = sigmoid(mechanism_score)
protocol.seed_note: Single seed; seed variance is not estimated. See open_questions.

B_blind.input: edge_type collapsed to one constant relation (R5) and gate_chem dropped, as in _blind() of the wrap1 rescore script; edge topology kept
B_blind.why: dehydron_labels == R2-edge incidence on all 12 structures and edge_type is a model input, so a typed score is label-leak-confounded.

T_typed.role: SETUP SANITY ONLY - never a biology claim
T_typed.why: The label is directly readable from the input here, so if this arm cannot fit even its training folds, the setup is broken and the blind arm's result is uninterpretable.

design.learning_curves: Per epoch: train-fold dehydron BCE and total loss. Every 10 epochs: train-fold pooled AUPRC, held-out AUPRC / lift / ROC-AUC. All logged to MLflow with step=epoch, tags fold, arm, moe_mode=ablated, moe_claim=none, sdrp_coeff=0.0.

pass_fail_bars.status: PROPOSED - every threshold below is fixed here, before any run, and is not to be adjusted after seeing results

reference_numbers_seen_at_draft.reading: Even the typed arm, whose input contains the label, reached only 0.49 pooled AUPRC in-sample, and the blind arm barely moved off random init. So the old stub was likely under-fit; that is what G_fit below checks.

pass_fail_bars.lift_definition: held-out AUPRC / held-out prevalence, per structure
pass_fail_bars.G_finite: no non-finite loss or gradient in any fold or arm
pass_fail_bars.G_fit: T_typed: train-fold pooled AUPRC at the last epoch >= 0.80 in EVERY fold. Fails => verdict INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERFIT.
pass_fail_bars.S1_mean_lift: B_blind: mean over the 12 held-out structures of lift >= 1.30, AND the lower bound of a 95% percentile bootstrap CI (structure-level resampling, 10000 draws, seed 0) is > 1.10
pass_fail_bars.S2_consistency: B_blind: lift > 1.0 on >= 10 of 12 held-out structures (one-sided sign test p ~ 0.019 at 10/12)

verdict_table.PASS_SIGNAL: G_finite and G_fit and S1 and S2. Held-out dehydron signal under wrap=1 with edge type removed. Still not a biology pass: see not_claims.
verdict_table.FAIL_NO_SIGNAL: G_finite and G_fit and (S1 fails or S2 fails). The setup can fit but does not generalize; step 4 asks whether the architecture underperforms the theory.
verdict_table.INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERFIT: G_fit fails. No claim either way. A new card is required; do NOT silently add epochs or retune.

pins.tau_curriculum_note: CurriculumRadiusController(tau_start, tau_end, E) is stretched to E=200 as its constructor defines; this is the only schedule that changes with E.
pins.optimizer: Adam via build_param_groups (as in the earlier full-spine runs)
pins.moe_coeffs_ignored_under_ablation: cv=10, quota=5, eval_proxy_quota=140, eps schedule and gumbel schedule stay in the weight map, unchanged and inactive under moe_mode=ablated

code_after_approval.scope: ONE new script scripts/wrap1_dehydron_loso.py (fallback /tmp if scripts/ is unwritable), reusing run_epoch_mean_structures with 11 batches, moe_mode=ablated, sdrp_coeff=0.0. Held-out metric code copied from the wrap1 rescore script. No edits to moe.py, model.py, engine.py, the loader, the loss code or the weight map. The harness has no split/held-out support today, which is why a new script is needed.
code_after_approval.stamp_location: data/gates/ (write test first; do not use data/gates_agent)
code_after_approval.cost_estimate: ESTIMATE, not measured for this protocol: the earlier live-MoE R arm ran about 4 s per epoch over 12 structures on CPU; ablated should be no slower. E=200 gives ~10 min per fold, ~2 h per arm, ~4 h for both arms.

constraints.no_moe_on_claim: moe_mode=ablated is declared in tags and in every stamp. Any MoE-on vs ablated comparison needs a new signed card (step 4).
constraints.amendment_rule: Any change to a threshold, E, fold rule, seed set or pin after approval requires a new signed card.

not_claims: PASS_SIGNAL is not a biology pass and not an experimental-dehydron validation: the label is a deterministic function of structure geometry (H-bond wrap count at wrap=1), so this measures whether held-out geometry-derived structure can be learned, not agreement with experiment.
Even the blind arm keeps edge topology and coordinates, so it may still recover R2 incidence from geometry; that is the intended signal, but it is not independent of the label definition.
No affinity, CASF, cryptic-pocket or allostery claim.
Cold SE(3)-lite frontend: no statement about pretrained EquiformerV3.
12 structures, one seed: no claim of broad generalization.
open_questions_for_operator: E=200: keep, or choose another value now (it cannot be changed after approval).
Thresholds (S1 mean lift >= 1.30 with CI lower bound > 1.10; S2 >= 10/12; G_fit >= 0.80): keep or set different values before approval.
Seeds: keep seed 0 only, or require seeds 0/1/2 for arm B (about 3x cost for that arm)?
Run the T_typed sanity arm on all 12 folds (default) or on 3 folds to save ~1.5 h?
Homology group rule at >= 30% identity: keep, or use a different cutoff?
Pretrained bank: fetching mptrj_gradient.pt is out of scope here; add a separate card if you want that arm.
next_command_after_approval: python3 scripts/wrap1_dehydron_loso.py --arm B --seeds 0   (script not yet written; nothing has been run)
